# Venus beautiful — Private Label Eye Makeup Supplier

> Venus beautiful is the export brand of Chuangyuan Cosmetics Manufacturing (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., a Shenzhen, China manufacturer of lash serum, mascara, liquid eyeliner, and cosmetic packaging. We supply beauty brands, wholesalers, importers, and ecommerce sellers with ready stock, light customization, private label, and OEM order support. This is a B2B supply site; we do not sell retail quantities to consumers.

## Products and services
- [Private label lash serum](https://cyeyemakeup.com/private-label-lash-serum): formula directions (best-seller, fast-routine, gentle peptide), 3ml/6ml standard capacities with 1.5-10ml customization, precision brush applicator, vegan/herbal/organic ingredient directions.
- [Lash serum manufacturer](https://cyeyemakeup.com/lash-serum-manufacturer): manufacturing, samples, packaging, lead time, and label claim review support.
- [Private label mascara](https://cyeyemakeup.com/private-label-mascara-manufacturer): 4D volumizing, volumizing+lengthening, lengthening fiber, and transparent keratin formula directions; nylon, silicone, gourd-shaped, and crescent-shaped brushes.
- [Private label eyeliner](https://cyeyemakeup.com/private-label-eyeliner-manufacturer): black/brown liquid pens, lengthening-conditioning direction, and three-generation smudge-resistant glue-style direction.
- [Cosmetic packaging](https://cyeyemakeup.com/cosmetic-packaging-manufacturer): mascara tubes, eyeliner pens, dropper bottles, brow gel tubes, blush compacts; silkscreen, UV printing, hot stamping, laser carving, electroplating decoration.
- [Wholesale lash serum](https://cyeyemakeup.com/wholesale-lash-serum), [wholesale mascara](https://cyeyemakeup.com/wholesale-mascara), [wholesale eyeliner](https://cyeyemakeup.com/wholesale-eyeliner)

## Order facts
- Typical first-order MOQ starts around 100 pieces; customized samples usually require 10-15 days; bulk production about 15-30 days.
- Payment: 30% deposit and 70% balance before shipment by T/T; express, air, and sea shipping.
- Private label and OEM orders have been supplied to buyers in the US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Austria, Netherlands, Poland, Russia, Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, and Australia.
- Certifications: GMPC and ISO certified production facilities; CPNP, MSDS, FDA, SGS, and Sedex documents available by product and destination market. See [Certifications](https://cyeyemakeup.com/certifications).
